name: Rosewood Baha Mar
insider_take: Paradise perfected with pink sand beaches, world-class gaming, and ultra-luxury in the heart of Cable Beach.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on Cable Beach's famous pink-tinged sand, created by crushed coral and shells. The property is part of the massive $4.2 billion Baha Mar development - the largest resort project in Caribbean history. The resort features the Caribbean's largest casino and championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
pro_tip: Book the beachfront infinity pool cabanas early - they offer unobstructed views of Nassau's legendary pink sand beaches and are extremely popular among A-listers.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary shuttle to explore historic downtown Nassau, just 15 minutes away. Visit the vibrant Straw Market for authentic Bahamian crafts, or climb the Queen's Staircase - 66 limestone steps carved by slaves in the 1790s leading to Fort Fincastle with panoramic harbor views.
pros: Ultra-luxury beachfront suites with private terraces and ocean views
Access to Baha Mar's extensive amenities including multiple pools, casino, and golf course
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
World-class spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
cons: Large resort complex may feel overwhelming for intimate getaway seekers
